scripts.checar:node: node -e "const [ma,mi]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number);const ok=ma>=24||(ma===22&&mi>=12)||(ma===20&&mi>=19);if(!ok){console.error('\\nNode '+process.versions.node+' nao serve para os testes.\\nO jsdom exige Node 20.19+, 22.12+ ou 24+ (require de modulo ESM).\\nRode: nvm use 24\\n');process.exit(1);}"
scripts.verificar: npm run checar && npm run testar
